# gpcn_virtualmachine_sizes (Data Source)

Retrieves available virtual machine sizes for a given datacenter. Results can be filtered by category and minimum specifications

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpcn = {
      source  = "Global-Private-Cloud-Network/gpcn"
      version = "~>0.5.4"
    }
  }
}

provider "gpcn" {
  host = "https://api.gpcn.com"
}

# Lookup a datacenter first
data "gpcn_datacenters" "central_us" {
  country_name = "United States"
  region_name  = "Central"
  name         = "Chicago"
}

# List all general-purpose sizes with at least 4 CPU cores and 8 GB RAM
data "gpcn_virtualmachine_sizes" "general_medium_plus" {
  datacenter_id = data.gpcn_datacenters.central_us.datacenters[0].id
  category      = "general-purpose"
  min_cpu       = 4
  min_memory_gb = 8
}

# Use the first matching size in a virtual machine resource
# resource "gpcn_virtualmachine" "example" {
#   size_id = data.gpcn_virtualmachine_sizes.general_medium_plus.sizes[0].id
#   ...
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter_id` (String) The ID of the datacenter to retrieve sizes for

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter sizes by category code. Must be one of: "general-purpose", "memory-optimized"
- `min_cpu` (Number) Filter to sizes with at least this many CPU cores
- `min_memory_gb` (Number) Filter to sizes with at least this much RAM in GB
- `min_storage_gb` (Number) Filter to sizes with at least this much base storage in GB

### Read-Only

- `sizes` (Attributes List) List of virtual machine sizes matching the specified filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category code this size belongs to (e.g. "general-purpose")
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPU cores
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (SKU ID) of the size. Use this as the size_id in a gpcn_virtualmachine resource
- `memory_gb` (Number) Amount of RAM in GB
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the size (e.g. "G-Small-1")
- `sku_code` (String) Short code identifying the size (e.g. "vm-gen-small-1")
- `storage_gb` (Number) Amount of base storage in GB
